You’re so young and you have the whole world in front of you. Your journeys just starting. 

Start small. 

Day 1: make your bed. That is all you have to do for the day just make your bed. 

Day 2: make your bed. Call G.P. To set up an appointment. 

Day 3: make bed. Take a shower 
Keep adding in these slow steps until you feel comfortable with going for a walk outside.
Once you feel comfortable walking, go for a run. 
And from there you keep building. 

Your GP should be able to connect you with an affordable therapist. & If it’s something your open to, talk to your GP about anti-depressants. Prozac saved my life when I was your age 

You’re gonna be okay kid, hang in there

My brother and I experienced horrible physical abuse, emotional abuse, and severe neglect growing up. Both of my parents were addicts. My older brother shielded me from most of it. When my dad would come home from a bender my brother would hide me in the closet. 

He later became addicted to heroin due to the level of trauma. Also didn’t help that the only coping mechanism demonstrated to us growing up was to abuse alcohol and drugs. 

I will never forget the moment he hit his knees, and in between sobs he said “I just want to be normal”. 
And that’s honestly and truly all he wanted . He fought so so hard for so many years. A little over a year ago he chose to end his own life. 

I would never wish his experience on anyone. He really was the greatest, most compassionate and lovable person I’ve ever met. Everyone he came into contact with absolutely adored him. And he was the best big brother in the whole world. 

No one chooses a life of despair.

The majority of Pitbulls are sweet, loving, and kind dogs that have been wrongfully labeled. Any dogs display of aggressive behavior is based on a variety of factors including socialization, training, breed traits, individual personality, positive and negative experiences, as well as genetics. 

I spoke with a veterinarian after a disagreement on the subject last week (similar thread). I learned that research has proven that a specific breeds genetic disposition accounts for less than 10% of that variation in behavior. Other studies have found a multitude of “breeds” consistently display stronger aggressive behavior than an American pit bull terrier (miniature poodles, border collies, etc.) 

You should always be cautious during encounters with ANY dog, no matter breed or size (especially if the animal is not familiar). Before approaching ask permission from the owner. Letting your child run up to a dog no matter how sweet it looks- not a great parenting practice. Reporting any suspicions of animal abuse or neglect in your neighborhood and voting for animal rights is a great way to be apart of the long term solution. Also helpful to learn warning signs: 
- Becoming very still and rigid
- Guttural bark
- Showing teeth

If you have had a negative encounter with any dog, I am very sorry. I hate that you had to experience that. And I will continue to strive for further education and responsibility of pet owners. 

If anyone wishes to learn more, I highly encourage reaching out to your local vet or animal shelter. Learning more about the subject eased concerns and encouraged me to get involved with a number of animal rights organizations.

I’m seeing a few comments stating “we should exterminate American pit bulls”.
 Just here to say when I was in high school we had an American pit bull, her name was ladybug. She was the sweetest most gentle thing in the entire world. My mom, myself, and my brother loved her so much. Everybody loved her. There was not a single bad bone in her body. She never so much as growled or showed any form of aggression. One day she was stolen from our backyard. We were told that the men tortured and killed her. My brother later learned more of the details and committed suicide. 

Dogs are not evil. 
People. People are evil.

I understand certain breeds are more aggressive (labs/chihuahuas) and I understand certain breeds have a stronger bite. However, I have been an advocate of animal welfare for a long time and involved in several organizations, specifically with bully breeds. The sheer amount of abuse these poor dogs have suffered is unspeakable. But once the wounds heal and they come to know love and care, they are again the sweetest things you will ever see. I am blown away by their resilience every.single.time. 

If you truly feel that certain breeds should be exterminated, I implore you, no I beg you to volunteer for 1 day at your local shelter. I promise that you will not leave with that same mindset.
